hooks.name: Block terraform apply from agent
hooks.description: Plan-only discipline: agents must never run terraform apply (the operator applies; see .kiro/steering/delegation-and-safety.md). Blocks any shell command containing a terraform apply invocation (exit 2).

action.command:
cmd=$(python3 -c "import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
ti=d.get('toolInput') or d.get('tool_input') or {}
print(ti.get('command','') if isinstance(ti,dict) else '')" 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "terraform([[:space:]]+-chdir=[^[:space:]]+)?[[:space:]]+apply"; then echo "BLOCKED: terraform apply is operator-only (plan-only discipline, .kiro/steering/delegation-and-safety.md). Produce a terraform plan and hand it off to the operator." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
